name: Times used
hint: how many times this command has been used, not counting this one; {uses} is the same thing (approximate)
desc: How many times this command has been used in your channel, not counting the one printing it. It counts every use, whichever name was typed, and needs no counter. {uses} is the older spelling of the same value. The total is approximate: the bot batches its counting, so it can be up to a minute behind.
